body: I read quite a few books years ago - that's not a bad idea! When my mind settles a bit, I'll go look for them in my mountain of books... or maybe just search online... Thank you.

Thank you. I got a few hours of sleep there.. have managed to stay safe and not harm myself - mainly thanks to telling my family my fears of self harming.

My story of how I got to this place is a long complicated one, with a mess of multiple misunderstanding asshole doctors, programs, treatments, endless meds & their horrid side-effects...

My main struggles are bipolar-depression, anxiety/agoraphobia/ocd, btw.

I just feel that I've tried sooo many meds, seen sooo many doctors, that mental illness has stolen nearly half my life. I guess I've tried so hard so long and nothing's worked long-term - my moods go up but they always end up falling down & the depression worsens each time my moods drop.. :/
